name: Bask Bile
subtitle: for the melting of troops and stuff
rules: COST – Pick a character or faction. -- EFFECT – Inflict 5 damage to the character or faction.
flavor: Available in french onion, barbeque ranch, or original nacho cheese flavor.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating. No artist credit in footer.

name: Bask Bomb
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Henry Gunawan
rules: COST – Play this only when you are attacking and your opponent is blocking. Destroy an attacking character you control. X is twice that character's strength. Y is that character's strength. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage divided however you want to the blocking party. Inflict Y damage divided however your opponent wants to the attacking party.
notes: Catalog uses 'Deploy this only' and 'an opponent'/'that opponent' templating for 'Play this only' / 'your opponent'. Artist (Henry Gunawan) credited in subtitle; footer only says ARTIST SERIES.

name: Berserker Corps
subtitle: shhh...the screaming arouses them
rules: This card gains 1 strength for each token on it. -- At the start of your turn, you may destroy a character you control. If you don't, destroy this card. If you do, put X tokens on this card, where X is the destroyed character's strength.
flavor: Got juice?
notes: Catalog rephrases as 'pick a character you control. If you do, destroy it. ... Otherwise, destroy this card.' Same play.

name: Bladefist Doomwing
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Kenfoo
rules: UNIQUE BLADEFIST -- FIREBREATHING -- COST – Pick a number for X. Pay twice X. Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the character.
flavor: The name Big McLargehuge was already taken.
notes: Catalog 'Choose a number for X. Pay X+X.' = 'Pick a number for X. Pay twice X.' Artist (Kenfoo) credited in subtitle; footer only says ARTIST SERIES.

name: Bloodcurdling Bulldozer
subtitle: as scary as he thinks he is
rules: If this card attacks, you may pick a character. If you do, deplete that character.
flavor: "OHHH YEEEAAHHH!!!" — K.M.
notes: Printed 'If this card attacks ... deplete that character'; catalog 'When ... deplete it'. Same play. Attribution 'K.M.' is on the same line as the quote.

name: Cannon Squadron
subtitle: ready! aim!
rules: FIRE! -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick 2 or fewer characters. -- EFFECT – Inflict up to 2 damage divided however you want to the characters.

name: Crazed Deputy
subtitle: a tad unstable
rules: If this card is blocked, it gains 2 strength and 2 life this turn.
flavor: "What do you mean my shoulder pads make me look like a dandy? RAR! blargity blarg BLARGH!"
notes: Printed 'If this card is blocked'; catalog 'When'. Same play.

name: Creaky Old Swordsman
subtitle: i'm getting too old for this shit
flavor: "...he says if I don't grease him up first he just can't seem to get into it..."
notes: No rules text on card or in catalog.

name: Dragon Catheter
subtitle: it's disturbingly comfortable
rules: At the start of your turn, you must put a token on the character with the highest strength. If there is a tie, you decide which character gets the token. -- All characters gain 1 strength for each token on them.
flavor: "Well at least our job is better than the guys who have to clean up."
notes: Card says 'you must put a token'; catalog says 'put a token' (mandatory either way).

name: Dragon Juice
subtitle: what did you think the catheter was for?
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 5 strength.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating.

name: Dragon Rider
subtitle: commanding from above
rules: This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each "dragon" card you control.
flavor: A dragon and his rider are peers. The rider rides at the will of the dragon. They are the captains of the field, circling the battle, landing only to deliver punishment where needed.
notes: Printed with quotes around "dragon".

name: Dragon Tank
subtitle: delivers the biggest beatings ever
rules: At the start of your turn, you may destroy a character your opponent controls. If you don't, destroy this card instead.
flavor: Pulled into battle by mighty basks, the dragon tank is feared above all else. Even if its victims can disable the enormous machinery, the basks remain to spew their acidic venom in an annihilating torrent of pain.
notes: Catalog rephrases as 'pick a character an opponent controls. If you do, destroy it. Otherwise, destroy this card.' Same play.

name: Dragon's Anthem
subtitle: inspirational and inflammatory
rules: This turn, your characters gain 5 strength.
flavor:
Crush your enemies.
See them driven before you.
Hear the lamentations of the women.

name: Dragon's Quarters
subtitle: dragonomically designed
rules: At the start of your turn, you may pick a character. If you do, this card inflicts X+1 damage to that character, where X is the number of "dragon" cards you control.
flavor: "Excuse me?...Is this barracks handicap acce...Oh no! ARGH! NO! <blumph> <mumph> crunch, crunch, crunch, crunch, munch...gulp...<BURP>... "
notes: Printed 'to that character'; catalog 'to it'. Same play.

name: Dragon's Strategy
subtitle: brilliant and perverse
rules: Your opponent's faction loses 2 influence. Draw a card.
flavor: "When the fathers see their disemboweled children, they'll lose heart and that is the time to strike."
notes: Catalog 'An opponent's faction' for printed 'Your opponent's faction'.

name: Eye Gouge
subtitle: less talking, more screaming
rules: COST – Pick a blocking character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 3 damage to the character.
flavor: "Ach! My eyes! The goggles, they do nothing!"
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating.

name: Flaming Barduse
subtitle: harbinger of sticky, burning doom
rules: COST – You may pick 2 or fewer characters. -- When this card enters play, if you picked characters as part of this card's cost then inflict up to 2 damage divided however you want to the characters. (If you didn't pay this card's cost then you cannot inflict damage.)
flavor: "In a state of supreme agitation, the mighty barduse vomits a sticky, viscous mess which bursts into a white-hot flame, consuming everything it touches."
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating and omits the printed italic reminder '(If you didn't pay this card's cost then you cannot inflict damage.)'; catalog says 'to those characters'.

name: Gruesome Trophies
subtitle: oh boy, not the toupee story again...
rules: At the start of your turn, you may pick a character. If you do, deplete that character.
flavor: "...and that one over there is from the trip to Gidea with the wife and kids... and the little one with the three nipples and the toupee, funny story about that..."
notes: Printed 'deplete that character'; catalog 'deplete it'.

name: Hammer Smash
subtitle: if your head gets in the way, too bad
rules: COST – Flip a coin. If you win X is 2, otherwise X is 1. Pick X or fewer items. -- EFFECT – Destroy the items.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating.

name: Heirloom Incinerator
subtitle: destroyer of ancestry and culture
rules: If this card inflicts damage to a faction, you may pick an item. If you do, destroy that item.
flavor: "Quit your blubbering old man! You and your stuff are going to a better place!"
notes: Printed 'If this card inflicts damage ... destroy that item'; catalog 'When ... destroy it'. Same play. 'and' is underlined in the flavor.

name: Hidden Sniper
rules: SHARPSHOOT -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 1 damage to the character.

name: Humiliating Torture Apparatus
subtitle: stop smiling, it hurts!
rules: If a card is depleted, that card's controller's faction loses 1 influence. (Resources don't deplete when used; they attach to your faction.)
flavor: Some torturers disguise their identities. They save the cutest costumes for their cruelest atrocities.
notes: Printed 'If a card is depleted'; catalog 'When'. Same play.

name: Kettinger
subtitle: i think you got him
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 2 strength. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Pay 3. Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
notes: Badges print +2 STR, +0 LIFE, +0 SPD.

name: Menacing Mauler
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Zi Jian
rules: If this card is blocked, inflict 1 damage to each member of the blocking party.
flavor: Zi Jian had a third testicle. He cut it off and threw it into the ocean. It's now commonly known as the continent of Australia.
notes: Printed 'If this card is blocked'; catalog 'When'. Same play. Artist (Zi Jian) credited in subtitle; footer only says ARTIST SERIES.

name: Oversoon Lightfoot
subtitle: the battle is next Tuesday
flavor: Early to rise, early to die.
notes: No rules text on card or in catalog. 'next' is underlined in the subtitle.

name: Plodding Brute
subtitle: killing at his own pace
flavor: Large and uncoordinated, the Brutes travel just behind the main army to ensure that survivors won't be overlooked.
notes: No rules text on card or in catalog.

name: Rabid Sarume
subtitle: bookish and brutal
rules: When this card enters play, inflict 1 damage to all your opponent's characters.
flavor: "Let's see...sarcophyle, sardines... ah, here it is. Sarume... aaaaaauuuugh!"

name: Rage
notes: Sideways (landscape) staple resource card: WARLORD banner on the left, STAPLE RESOURCE above the name RAGE. Footer shows a logo and the word STAPLE where other cards show rarity; no collector number printed. No rules text on card or in catalog.

name: Raging Bask
subtitle: bloated reptile on a vomitous rampage
rules: If this card is blocked, you may assign its damage to the faction or location you are attacking instead of the blocking party.
flavor: Basks are theorized to be nothing more than a tiny brain atop a mountain of bile. None have survived to validate this claim.
notes: Printed trigger/condition is 'If this card is blocked' and the redirect target is 'the faction or location you are attacking'. Catalog says 'While this card is attacking ... battle damage to the target of the attack'. Probably a modern re-templating with the same practical result, but the condition and target wording differ, so flagged.

name: Reckless Challenger
subtitle: fearless and foolish
rules: At the end of your turn, if this card started the turn on your side and did not attack, destroy it.
flavor: "I don't care if it's one at a time or all together...I'm going to make ALL OF YOU my bitch."
notes: Printed 'started the turn on your side and did not attack'; catalog 'started the turn under your control and did not attack this turn'. 'ALL OF YOU' is underlined in the flavor.

name: Reveille Tower
subtitle: echoing the anthems of tyranny
rules: All your characters gain 1 strength.
flavor: Its chilling sound slices the morning air like a razor-sharp sword. The eerie melody foreshadows the dawn of a dark age.

name: Rudo Mangod
subtitle: frightful adonis of infamous temperament
rules: UNIQUE RUDOLPHUS -- PUNCH -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. Pick a character. X is that character's strength. Y is this card's strength. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to this card. Inflict Y damage to the character.
notes: Printed 'that character's strength'; catalog 'its strength'.

name: Scout
subtitle: omen of the coming horde
flavor: Only the most disagreeable warriors are chosen to be scouts. They comb the countryside in disguise, searching for riches, women, and easily killed men. A town can only pray that it has less of these things than its neighbors.
notes: No rules text on card or in catalog.

name: Shriever Attack
subtitle: they'll creatively assist you in dying
rules: Inflict 2 damage to all characters.
flavor: "I ascended the peak towards Avery's Hern. The shear nervy demeanor of the raven shyer filled my soul with a rasher envy. But alas, the sound of the haver syren from Neva Sherry foretold the dangers of these hills...a cancer these shrievers be!" — Henry Raves, nailer of The Style
notes: Attribution follows the quote on the same printed line.

name: Siege Machine
subtitle: intimidating weapon of penetration
rules: BATTERING RAM -- COST – Pay 2. Destroy a resource you control. -- EFFECT – Your opponent's faction loses 1 influence.
flavor: "I will not sacrifice this city. We've made too many compromises already; too many retreats. They invade our fields, and we fall back. They eradicate entire towns, and we fall back. Not again. The line must be drawn HERE! This far, NO FURTHER! And I will make them pay for what they've done."
notes: Catalog 'An opponent's faction' for printed 'Your opponent's faction'. 'HERE' and 'NO FURTHER' are underlined in the flavor.

name: Skewer
subtitle: everyone gets a turn
rules: COST – Pick a number for X. Pay twice X. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the character.
flavor: "Eww... looks like that one had corn for dinner."
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating and 'Choose a number for X. Pay X+X.'

name: Sleeping Guard
subtitle: he didn't like being human anyway
rules: While your opponent controls a character, this card gains 1 strength and 1 life.
flavor: Failure to do one's duty often results in "volunteering" for the latest dragon juice experiments.
notes: Catalog 'While an opponent controls a character' for printed 'your opponent'.

name: Stalwart Soldier
subtitle: rejecting the moral decay of his brethren
flavor: "It was early winter when I went forth from my home base. After many months I found a cave containing tropical coconuts. Using these I fashioned a crude hovel and lived in it for several days. Soon I befriended a pack of bears and we traveled east, towards Macaroon. There I took up small odd jobs under the name of Mister Pilkington. But perhaps I've said too much..."
notes: No rules text on card or in catalog.

name: Strength In Numbers
subtitle: they can't kill us all! attack!
rules: COST – Play this only when you are attacking. X is the number of members in the attacking party. -- EFFECT – This turn, all members of the attacking party gain X strength and X life.
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating and 'Deploy this only while you are attacking'.

name: Tactician Vacation
subtitle: effective immediately
rules: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. -- If you played this card in response to a tactic, that tactic has no effect. -- For the rest of the turn, no tactics can be played.
flavor: In fact, take the rest of the week off too.
notes: Printed text has no COST/EFFECT labels; catalog makes 'cannot respond' an EXTRA COST (changes when it applies), says 'terminate the tactic' for printed 'that tactic has no effect', and 'Your opponents' for 'Your opponent'. Probably modern re-templating, but cost-vs-effect structure differs, so flagged.

name: Target Practice
subtitle: drunken pastime of the cruel
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 2 damage to the character.
flavor: "I like to nail 'em right after they take the first bite. Whammo! Right between the eyes, granny!"
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST: templating.

name: Warrior Prodigy
subtitle: just a morning workout
flavor: The most talented fighters are encouraged from a young age. They're given all the food they can eat, all the women they can handle, and all the men they can kill.
notes: No rules text on card or in catalog.
